DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Pulmonary Interstitial Glycogenosis.

The chest X-ray findings of ground-glass opacities without hyaline membrane disease are classic for this condition, likely triggered by maternal diabetes or intrauterine hyperglycemia. Given the absence of pink, frothy urine (ruling out pulmonary edema) and the specific radiological pattern, I am confident in this diagnosis.
